sentence: This project studies how graphs can be mapped into curved space and uses curvature-like inequalities to measure how much a geometric structure is distorted.
This project uses artificial intelligence to speed up discoveries in natural hazard engineering, using landslide hazards as its example.
This project looks for very small gene editing systems that plant viruses could carry into whole plants to edit their genes quickly.
This project builds backscatter tags that let robots track their position precisely and send sensor data at the same time.
This project builds tools and methods that use microbiomes to check and manage the health of built environments.
This project holds events that introduce AI concepts and classroom uses to middle and high school teachers and counselors.
This project builds a deep learning framework that studies driver behavior and attention while protecting drivers' privacy.
This project holds a conference that brings together higher education, industry and government partners to discuss innovation and economic development.
This project builds a way for robots to find their way in unknown environments by reasoning about rooms and doors.
This project builds a network of portable chemical sensors that measure volatile organic compounds in outdoor air and tests it during a wildfire.
This project builds an artificial intelligence based tool that maps heat across whole cities so strategies to cool them can be tested.
This project builds an online cybersecurity certificate with stackable college credits.
This project tries to turn living cells into a memory that can store, erase and rewrite information in their own genetic code.
This project supports research in fields such as knot theory, number theory and mathematical biology.
This project tries to find out how RNA is sorted and packaged into extracellular vesicles and moved to other cells.
